entries.implementationStatus: not-yet-implemented: the adapter is gap G2 of docs/polaris-generation/TRACKER.md; no provider SDK is imported anywhere in apps, packages or scripts. Until an implementation exists and its version is recorded in the snapshot, RFC4-3 admits no output from this entry. implementationVersion stays null (Unknown), never a placeholder
entries.contractVersionSource: the value the adopted Butlers observer entry declares for the same contract; re-derive by script before the offering

governingBehaviorContract.version: Unknown: pinned by the offering step to the generation specification bytes in force, base REQ-polaris-generation-017 plus the understanding and tree-form amendments
governingBehaviorContract.signedBy: pending exact owner act over this entry

entries.authorizationModeDerivation: the entry needs an effective exact owner act (RFC3-16(a)) and the effective egress consent for the (project:syzygy, provider:anthropic) pair; owner-trusted-bootstrap while those acts are state (1); every other combination dispatches nothing
entries.provenanceDisclosure: The route is admitted on owner-trusted records; independent audit is not configured.
entries.determinism: every output is a recording of what the provider returned at a capture instant; a re-dispatch may legitimately differ. The generated prose is editorial inference, never an Observed claim and never repeatable by contract

typedAuthority.authorityTypeLabel: [Inferred] a provider is an external authority of project:syzygy under RFC4-1; the typed-authority list in the RFC names version control, hosting, the scheduler and the OpenSpec CLI as examples, so this type name is the drafter's
questions: What did the provider return for this exact request?
typedAuthority.readAuthority: none: the route reads no source. It transmits only the request the generator built, after the single egress check (RFC5-15), and receives one reply
typedAuthority.runDirectoryWrites: provider requests, replies, run records and the runtime's own state, including any session transcript, are written only inside the run directory under project:syzygy's state directory, outside git, from the start of the run; this is the egress record's retention line and the only local write
networkAccess: the Anthropic API, through the Claude Agent SDK runtime, signed in with the owner's account; no other destination

routeConditions.source: instances/egress-anthropic of the public-repo admission package; the egress record is the authority, this block only declares that the implementation will enforce it
routeConditions.tools: every tool the runtime offers is disabled; the model sees only the request carries
routeConditions.ambientContext: no instruction or memory files, user or project settings, MCP servers, hooks or environment summary; the working directory is an empty directory inside the run directory
routeConditions.telemetry: telemetry, error reporting and update checks are disabled; a run whose runtime cannot disable them does not start
routeConditions.stateLocation: a run whose runtime cannot keep its state and transcript inside the run directory does not start
routeConditions.acceptanceCheck: the adapter is accepted only when a captured request shows the system prompt and messages the generator built and nothing else; the acceptance test runs against a local capture endpoint before any real call
routeConditions.fallback: none: a failure never routes to another provider, to the direct API or to a tool; a different route is a new registry event

portMapping.note: [Observed] the ports exist; [Unknown] how the runtime reports usage, a model identifier and late receipts, so usage fields are Unknown rather than zero when unreported

unknowns: whether the Agent SDK on a subscription login can disable tools, ambient context and telemetry and can keep its transcript in the run directory (gap #21); the entry cannot be offered for the first real call until this is checked
the runtime's context window and rate limits
the provider's own retention under the signed-in account's terms, which the egress record discloses and does not promise

usageOrDispatchUncertain.note: the pipeline stops with effect-uncertain or usage-uncertain; a lease expiry never replays the request

failureStates.budgetExhaustedOrRejectedOutput: not a degradation state: distinct execution facts (ADAPTER-DECLARATIONS.md, failure behaviour), mapped to the existing claim-reason predicate
